notebook.title: Wajba MENA Recipe Image Audit and Verification Guide
notebook.limitation: NotebookLM reviewed the recipe metadata and image URLs, but the uploaded text/CSV sources did not contain image pixels or embedded visual metadata. Its confirmation is therefore a source-and-URL audit, not a pixel-level visual proof.

candidateReview.notebookFinding: Omani harees remains region-uncertain because the source identifies generic harees; the original third-party Food.com Muhammar candidate was rejected for unclear image rights and replaced with a CC BY 2.0 source.

maghreb-moroccan-harira.verification: Dish-specific file title and Moroccan soup recipe context.

maghreb-chicken-tagine-olives.sourceLabel: Wikimedia Commons — Moroccan chicken tagine with preserved lemons and olives
maghreb-chicken-tagine-olives.verification: File title names the exact chicken, preserved-lemon, and olive preparation.

maghreb-couscous-seven-vegetables.verification: File title and Commons categories identify Moroccan couscous with seven vegetables.

maghreb-chicken-pastilla.verification: French file title identifies chicken pastilla.

maghreb-msemen.verification: Commons structured data identifies the dish as Msemmen.

maghreb-sellou.sourceLabel: Wikimedia Commons — Sellou with Moroccan tea

saudi-chicken-kabsa.verification: Commons caption identifies chicken kabsa as a Saudi Arabian dish.

oman-harees.verification: Harees is identified, but the source does not prove this is the Omani regional presentation; keep a human regional visual check.

bahrain-muhammar.sourceLabel: ccnull.de — Bahraini Muhammar sweet rice with fish
bahrain-muhammar.verification: The source identifies Bahraini Muhammar sweet rice with fish and publishes the image under CC BY 2.0 with attribution. The page notes the image was AI-generated; retain human review for production authenticity and attribution compliance.

qatar-madrouba.verification: Dish-specific madrouba file; regional attribution should remain Qatar-focused in the recipe metadata.

palestine-musakhan.verification: Commons description identifies the traditional Palestinian dish of Musakhan.

levant-fattet-hummus.verification: Commons description explicitly identifies Palestinian hummus fatteh and the file is categorized as fattet hummus.

egypt-ful-medames.verification: Dish-specific ful medames file used by the ful medames article.

general-arabic-lentil-soup.verification: The article covers shorbat al-adas/Arabic lentil soup and the Commons image is an Egyptian lentil soup photograph.
